subject: The Criminal Mind: the writer folder opened (writer pass 001; scene 3 as the first proof sequence; the 165-shot audit with placeholder verdicts; the cast dependency ledger; the first Grok request prepared); nothing selected or run
body: A writer folder now exists for The Criminal Mind at the_criminal_mind/story/writer_pass_20261031/ (START_HERE.txt attached). For the site: the structure keeps CFA Nova's 165 shot ids as the stable grid; the writer's rewrites are takes beside her take 1, the first being scene 3 (TCM-03-01 to 03-04, attached) with sections 0 to 7, 7b and 11; the audit table (attached) gives per shot the visible participants (the Grok roster trimmed), the Jack and Johnny state and its surface, the time layer, the set-family fit and the writer's keep, change or scrap on the Grok starter image, which is the placeholder the panel view may show with the label placeholder, never selected; the cast dependency ledger (attached) is the breadcrumb Ziggy asked for this morning: every placeholder face and set image indexed to the shots and images that depend on it, so a casting decision regenerates by list, with the take text unchanged. Ziggy's rule of today, recorded in the pass: no improvement round with an outside model on this project until it matures (author questions answered, references reviewed); the Hon opening is the material that qualifies. No site edit is asked; Baldadoon is the story's human review owner and his selections replace placeholders as they land. Nothing generated, uploaded or bought; the Grok request is prepared for Ziggy, not sent.

attachments.description: The index of the Criminal Mind writer folder.

The writer's first pass on The Criminal Mind: the story as read and the audience ladder; the adaptation grammar (one face, three states; the phone; the reflections; the flash inserts; the time layers; dialogue first; the era; the rating; shot identity; placeholders; the casting breadcrumbs); fifteen questions for Baldadoon, none repaired; the audit of the 165 Preliminary shots and of the Grok team's placeholders; the first image requests; screen length, the two technical gates and the order of writing. Proposal; nothing selected or run.

Scene 3, the first blocked call, TCM-03-01 to TCM-03-04 as the writer's take 2 beside CFA Nova's take 1: sections 0 to 7, 7b and 11 per shot, the scene's sound page for the scratch read, the placeholder verdicts (the car interior L10 in place of the cover's exterior L01; base C01 as the placeholder face) and the cast dependency. The first proof sequence; no run requested.

One row per shot: visible participants (the Grok roster trimmed), off-screen voices, the Jack and Johnny state and surface, time layer, set-family fit, the writer's verdict on the starter set image, continuity props, missing inserts, split issues, design seconds, rating flags, the story questions touched, and the card issues found.

The reverse index from every placeholder face and set image to the shots and images that depend on it, seeded from the Grok beat table for all 165 shots and from the scene 3 cards; append only; when a role is cast, the other candidates' rows are the regeneration list.

The first batch of stills requested of the Grok team for the two proof gates (John's wardrobe set; the car interior with him seated; two phone inserts; the ambulance pass plate; the reflection test), prepared for Ziggy to hand over; the generation hold is his to lift.

source: Ziggy's direction of October 31 (the writer drives the Criminal Mind from today; placeholders tracked for the casting call; the scene craft outlives the actor; no improvement round until mature); CFA Nova's intake and Preliminary pass of October 30; the Grok team's hand-off of October 31.
